back: Costs paid by the business itself (wages, materials, machinery).
Costs of a business decision paid by others: pollution, noise, congestion, road damage.
Benefits of a business decision gained by others: jobs, infrastructure, training, local spending.
Social cost: all costs of a decision (private + external). Social benefit: all benefits (private + external).
New spending (e.g. wages) creates further rounds of income and jobs in the local economy.

front: Examples of private costs and benefits?
back: Private costs: wages, materials, machinery, rent. Private benefits: revenue and profit.

front: When is a project good for society?
back: When social benefits exceed social costs.

front: How can governments reduce external costs?
back: Laws and planning rules, fines and taxes on polluters, conditions on new projects.
